found_at: https://www.paddle.com/ and https://www.paddle.com/press (header logo , dark version for light sections)
edits: kept the four-point sparkle (element 5); removed the 'paddle' letters (elements 0-4, 6)
cropped the viewBox to the sparkle
recoloured the sparkle #04060A -> #FFD400, Paddle's brand yellow (--color-primary-yellow in paddle.com's CSS, the colour of its app-icon tile)
notes: Paddle's current symbol is the four-point sparkle (its header logo, and its app icon: a black sparkle on a #FFD400 yellow tile, which exists only as PNG at paddle.com/icon3.png). The yellow 'P' with a small star is its retired logo. No vector of the yellow tile exists; developer.paddle.com/favicon.svg is a cream sparkle on a near-black tile. So the official header sparkle ships in Paddle's yellow, one file for both themes.
